title: ThreatSwarm Evidence Entry
description: Schema for evidence collected during a penetration testing engagement

finding_ref.description: Reference to the associated finding ID

path.description: Relative path to the evidence file within the evidence/ directory

collected_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when evidence was collected

tool.description: Tool used to collect this evidence (e.g., nmap, sqlmap, burpsuite)

command.description: Command executed to obtain this evidence

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the evidence file for chain of custody

description.description: Brief description of what this evidence shows

redacted.description: Whether sensitive data in this evidence has been redacted
